messages:
Ara: FYI Solomon Edge EAP NDA inbound, countersign expected today. Need to finalize bench plan & telemetry whitelist.
Tom: Great. Partner requested: focus on 4-bit quant and cold-start latency for chat workloads.
Solomon-poc: We'll ship 4 dev modules next week and provide driver image `solomon-edge-4.img` + container `solomon/ref:2026-04`. Portal: https://partners.solomon/dev.
Legal-bot: NDA pending countersign. Forbidden telemetry: microcode dumps, JTAG traces. Allowed: perf counters, memory, limited kernel logs.
Mike: Bench proposals: 1) cold-start chat (prompt+sampling) 2) steady-state generate (batching) 3) quant accuracy sweep (int4 vs int8). Use `bench-runner` harness.
Ops-Ella: Need exact cmds for infra template and desired golden image SHA. Also egress exception for partner portal.
Tom: Example commands:
```
bench-runner --model rwd-chat-7b --mode coldstart --seq 256 --batch 1 --out s3://bench/solomon/1845006789/cold
bench-runner --model rwd-chat-7b --mode throughput --seq 1024 --batch 32 --out s3://bench/solomon/1845006789/throughput
bench-runner --model rwd-chat-7b --mode quant-sweep --quant int4,int8 --out s3://bench/solomon/1845006789/quant
```
Mike: Add flags `--strip-firmware` and `--anonymize` before upload. Also capture `--gpu-pci`, `--power`, `--p50p99` metrics.
Bench-bot: Run queued on infra-edge-2, est 4h. Artifacts will post to s3://bench/solomon/1845006789/meta.json when finished.
Solomon-poc: We'll provide power API and a small helper to normalize wattages. Shipping Wed.
Legal-bot: Reminder: partner copy must be scrubbed per NDA. Maria/Legal will review before sharing externally.
Ops-Ella: I'll create an infra job template and request egress access. Please attach image SHA in this thread once available.
Ara: Plan for a short cross-functional sync Thurs 11am PT to review numbers and decide go/no-go for early marketing preview.
Tom: Noted. If any blockers, post here. :thumbsup:
Bench-bot: Run complete: coldstart p50=45ms, p99=210ms, throughput=1600 tok/s (int8), int4 accuracy delta=+0.8% loss on perplexity. Full scrubbed summary -> s3://bench/solomon/1845006789/summary-scrubbed.json
Ara: Thanks team. Next: legal review, partner check, infra image finalize.
